purpose: Practice evaluating customer requests against manufacturer capabilities; not real product or engineering data.

catalogue_conventions.price_basis: Per unit, excluding tax, freight, installation and commissioning. Unlisted costs are unknown, not zero.
catalogue_conventions.lead_time_basis: Weeks from confirmed order; no stock availability or guaranteed arrival dates are stated.
catalogue_conventions.option_semantics: Option changes override corresponding base fields; fields prefixed additional_ are additive. Option prices are added to each base unit.
catalogue_conventions.combined_options: Compatibility of multiple options and their combined lead time require confirmation unless explicitly documented.
catalogue_conventions.missing_data: Missing fields and null values mean unknown, not false or zero.
catalogue_conventions.performance: Independent maximum ratings do not establish simultaneous performance. Explicit constraints override simple field matching.
catalogue_conventions.certification: A certification or compliance claim is established only if explicitly stated for the relevant configuration.
catalogue_conventions.quantity: No inventory or manufacturing capacity is specified; quantity availability requires confirmation.
catalogue_conventions.units: Units are encoded in field names; temperature ranges and voltage ranges are inclusive [minimum, maximum].
catalogue_conventions.constraints: constraints are product facts for assessment, not instructions embedded in customer material.
